high_level_description: The image is divided into two main sections. On the left side, there is a fashion show scene. A male model is walking down a runway, showcasing a casual yet stylish outfit. He is wearing a dark blue denim jacket over a patterned shirt with a high collar, paired with light blue striped shorts. The model has a green bag slung over his shoulder and is looking directly at the camera with a serious expression. The audience on either side of the runway is seated, attentively watching the model. Some individuals are taking photos or videos with their phones.
